summary: All checks pass. No previous findings were raised, so none remain unresolved. The six changed paragraphs are accurate and well-scoped: ICC Safety capability claims are consistently framed as published descriptions requiring demonstration confirmation; the exception and no-action guidance paragraphs add procedural depth without introducing unsupported claims; the action-writing guidance is concrete and actionable; and the three effectiveness-verification paragraphs are distinct in purpose and do not repeat one another. All four subsections match the plan exactly: workflow elements (role, input, decision, record, exception), evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are present throughout. The illustrative example uses an unnamed Canadian manufacturer and is marked hypothetical in each occurrence. The Ontario JHSC guide is cited only in the third subsection and with an appropriate caution that plants outside Ontario must confirm what applies to them. Links use only the two supplied source URLs (icc-safety and ontario-jhsc-guide) plus an allowed internal site path. No FAQ section appears anywhere in the page, consistent with the plan assigning none to any subsection of this chapter. No scope boundary violations were detected; committee trend review and general CAPA practice are correctly deferred. Word count of approximately 2053 is within acceptable range of the 2000-word target.
